description: pkix-lint design: LintRunner returns Vec<Finding> and never returns Err or panics. Fatal only stops further lint evaluation, not chain validation. This is the correct design for a compliance advisory layer — enforcement (reject a TLS connection, block cert issuance) belongs at the integration boundary where the calling context is known. A contributor might suggest making Fatal return an Err for 'more obvious' handling; that would conflate advisory signals with hard failures and break the audit use-case (you always want all findings recorded, even for malformed certs).
title: Advisory-only lint architecture correctly separates enforcement from evaluation
